sections.label: Head
Eyes
sections.text:
Smarting in canthi ; lids red and puffy ; tar-
sal tumor. [Staph.]

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Catarrhal condition of both anterior and
posterior nostrils. Mucous polypus. Chronic catarrh;
discharge of large, irregular clinkers. Foul breath.
Crawling in nostrils, with lachrymation and sneezing.
Coryza, with stoppage of nostrils.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Vomiting of large quantities of dark-
green masses. Constant hiccough, attended with pain
in back. Unnatural appetite. Hiccough on eating, after
nursing.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Affection of finger-tips and joints of
toes. Tearing pains in arms and legs. Pains in toe-
nails, as if they had grown into flesh.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Itching of anus, and constant irritation in
the evening in bed. Ascarides, with nightly restlessness.
Crawling in rectum after stool.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Restless, with twitching, choking, and start-
ing up frightened.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Itching causes tossing about all night. Very
dry skin. Suppurating grooves in the nails.
